title: Build fldtanime.narc (field texture animations) from source
description:
Map ground-tile animations (sea, flowers, lamps, ...) live in a single prebuilt binary, res/prebuilt/data/fldtanime.narc. Member 0 is a table of {char name[16]; u8 frames[18][2] = (textureIndex, hold), 0xFF-terminated and 0xFF-padded}; member i+1 is an NSBTX holding the frames for entry i. At map load (src/overlay005/texture_resource_manager.c) each entry whose name matches a texture in the area's map texture set gets its texels swapped in VRAM every field tick. PDMS cannot see or edit any of this.

Goal: make the NARC source-built so adding an animation is 'drop in an NSBTX + edit JSON'.

Design:
- res/field/texture_animations/texture_animations.json: ordered list of {texture, frames, sequence:[{frame, hold}]}. Order = NARC member order.
- res/field/texture_animations/frames/*.nsbtx: one per entry, extracted from retail.
- tools/scripts/make_texture_animations.py: validates, encodes member 0, packs with nitroarc.
- Hard errors (retail passes all): name 1-16 ASCII chars and unique; 1-17 steps; frame index < texture count and != 0xFF; hold 0-255; all frame textures share format + size; format is palette-based (not 4x4 or direct); frame files listed in meson match those referenced in JSON.
- filesys.csv points at the built NARC; the prebuilt copy is removed.
- One-off extractor in tools/scripts/migration/.
- Tests: unit + integration (unittest, registered in meson test), e2e = BLESS=0 make check proves byte-identical ROM.
- Docs: docs/maps/texture_animations.md.

Verified: nitroarc round-trips the retail NARC byte-identically.

comments.author: jberben

Built NARC is byte-identical to retail (sha1 80c1ee...), ROM byte-identical to clean dev (2bac58...). 21 unit/integration tests pass via meson test. title: Lint: prop textures present in every area texture set that loads the prop
description: For each prop_model_set, check every model's texture and palette names exist in the area's prop_texture_set. Catches the silent white-prop failure at build time. Report retail baseline first; retail may already have gaps.

title: map_props.py: list/add/move/remove props in map_data .bin
description: CLI over the mapProps section of res/field/maps/data/map_data_NNN.bin (MapProp struct, 0x30 bytes, max 32). Use model names and tile coordinates instead of raw fx32; rewrite mapPropsSize header. Style after map_info.py.
notes: Implemented on tools/prop-tables (uncommitted): map_props.py list/add/move/remove, 26 tests. Findings: placed-prop rotation is never rendered; Marts etc. share land data; map_data_506 has a stray CRLF after its props. E2E: retail waterfall registered + placed in Twinleaf (112,880) builds; demo ROM saved in session scratchpad.

title: mapedit: TUI for map editing (Textual + uv)
description: A Textual app under tools/mapedit/, managed with uv, that wraps the map scripts. Every write goes through the scripts' own plan/preview logic; the TUI never edits files itself. v1 = props first: map browser, block tile grid with props/warps/NPCs, props panel (add/move/remove with preview + confirm), register-prop form (new_prop.py). Later: map_info, warp checks, new_map, free flags.
notes: v1 (props first) built on tools/mapedit, uncommitted: browser, block grid, props panel, register form; 31 TUI tests + meson test (when uv found). Verified layout by rendering pilot screenshots.

Data layer: map list, block tiles, events and props as plain data
Map browser and block tile-grid screen
Props panel: add/move/remove with preview and confirm
mapedit: map info, warp check, new map and free flag screens

title: Lint map texture sets against texture animations
description: Cross-check each map texture set against the texture animation table: base texture format/size must equal the frames' (retail mismatches: map_texture_set_000 'sea' and map_texture_set_014 'asasea' are 4-colour, frames are 16-colour), <=16 matches per set (MAX_TEXTURE_KEYS), and 16/32px sizes only (see CalcTextureDataSize issue). Needs a baseline for retail offenders so test output stays pristine.

title: Investigate CalcTextureDataSize width/height math for 8px and 64px textures
description: src/billboard_vram_transfer.c CalcTextureDataSize computes size as (field << 4) where the NNS encoding is (8 << field). Correct for 16/32px, gives 0 for 8px and 48 for 64px. Retail texture animations azt_wall02.1 (32x64) and wtk_kabe1-3 (64x64) go through this path, so they may only partially animate in retail. Confirm in melonDS before deciding on a fix (docs/bugs_and_glitches.md style). Also used by billboard VRAM transfers.

title: dev's blessed filesys/ROM manifests are out of date
description: On a clean checkout of dev (8dcf0a8f5), BLESS=0 make check fails: filesys.sha1 mismatches res/text/pl_msg.narc, res/field/scripts/scr_seq.narc, res/field/events/zone_event.narc, and rom_rev1.sha1 mismatches. Something was committed without re-blessing. Fix: run 'make' (which re-blesses) on dev and commit the manifests, after confirming those three archives are expected to have changed.

comments.author: jberben
comments.text: Root cause confirmed: manifests in 22d84f44f were blessed before the Twinleaf Rancher NPC (twinleaf_town.json text, scripts_twinleaf_town.s, events_twinleaf_town.json) was added. Building 22d84f44f with those 3 files reverted reproduces the blessed ROM eda29a... exactly and passes filesys.sha1. With them it builds 2bac58..., identical to current dev. The 3 archive hash changes (pl_msg d770fb, scr_seq 938002, zone_event dd214f) are purely the Rancher. Safe to re-bless.

title: Explore 'bring your own ROM' to keep retail assets out of the public repo
description: Concern: hosting retail-derived assets in the public origin repo. Today git tracks 157 .nsbtx files (all map texture sets, texture animation frames) plus 260 files under res/prebuilt/, all inherited from pret/pokeplatinum. Ignoring a subset gives no real protection (history + upstream still host them). A real fix: gitignore retail-derived assets and extract them from a user-supplied Platinum ROM at build time, keeping only hack-original assets tracked. Repo-wide design work; would also need a history rewrite to fully remove existing blobs.

title: Map prop pipeline: author, register and place custom props
description: Make adding a custom map prop (e.g. an animated waterfall) a source-level workflow. A prop touches: props/models (nsbmd + order), props/model_sets (JSON), props/texture_sets (per-area NSBTX; area_data.c:114 binds props to the AREA texset, model-embedded textures are ignored, missing textures render white silently), props/animations + prebuilt bm_anime_list.narc (model->anim map, 590 entries, 4 slots), prebuilt build_model_matshp.dat (indexed by model ID with no bounds check, map_prop_material_shape.c:62), and the props section of maps/data/map_data_NNN.bin. Authoring is external: Blender -> nns-blender-plugin (IMD/ITA) -> g3dcvtr -> nsbmd/nsbta; apicula for reference export and viewing only (it cannot import).

title: Build bm_anime_list.narc (prop animation lists) from source
description: res/prebuilt/arc/bm_anime_list.narc maps each prop model ID to up to 4 members of prop_animations.narc plus flags (MapPropAnimeListFile in include/overlay005/map_prop_animation.h). Make it source-built from JSON keyed by model and animation NAMES, so it follows the order files instead of raw indices. Must reproduce retail byte-for-byte (including the 0xFF-padding quirk noted at map_prop_animation.c 'BUG' comment). Proof: BLESS=0 make check.
acceptance_criteria: JSON source + generator + unit/integration tests in meson test; prebuilt NARC removed; BLESS=0 make check passes unchanged; docs updated.
notes: Done on branch tools/prop-tables, uncommitted: prop_animation_lists.json + make_prop_tables.py; make check green, ROM byte-identical, filesys.sha1 path-only change.

title: Build build_model_matshp.dat (prop material/shape table) from source
description: res/prebuilt/fielddata/build_model/build_model_matshp.dat has one locator per prop model (590) into a list of (materialID, shapeID) pairs (docs/maps/file_format_specifications.md). Lookup is by model ID with no bounds check, so every new model needs an entry. Make it source-built from JSON keyed by model name; models without an entry get count 0 (normal render path).
design: Changed from the original plan: draw lists are DERIVED from each nsbmd's render commands (SHP paired with preceding MAT), stable-sorted by material ID; animated models get an empty list. Matches 475/478 retail models; the other 3 (Twinleaf houses 022/023/236, door material drawn last) live in models/draw_order_overrides.json by material/shape name. New models need no matshp editing.
acceptance_criteria: JSON source + generator + tests; prebuilt file removed; BLESS=0 make check passes unchanged; docs updated.
notes: Done on branch tools/prop-tables together with pokeaotea-7 (one generator); make check green.

title: new_prop.py: register a custom prop in one step
description: Scaffold like new_map.py: given an nsbmd (+ optional animations and textures), add to models meson/order, anime list JSON, matshp JSON, chosen model sets, and merge its textures/palettes into those areas' prop texture sets (nitrobtx; check whether any prop texsets use 4x4 format, which nitrobtx cannot write). All-or-nothing, --dry-run.
design: Binary append-only merge (tools/scripts/nitro_textures.py): existing texture/palette bytes untouched, new data appended (palettes 16-byte aligned unless 4-colour), dictionaries rebuilt with a port of nitrobtx's Patricia tree builder. Same-name identical entries are shared, same-name different data is an error. No 4x4 support needed: no prop texture set uses it.
notes: Implemented on tools/prop-tables (uncommitted): new_prop.py + nitro_textures.py, 30 + 19 tests. E2E: registering retail waterfall prop_model_305 as test_waterfall into set 000 builds a ROM (591 table entries); reverted, BLESS=0 make check green. Follow-up idea: check NSBTA/NSBTP material and texture names against the model.
